name: Rockport Steel
old_description: Rockport Steel, located in Midcoast Maine, specializes in custom metal fabrication projects of all shapes and sizes. We believe everybody should have the ability to construct beautiful metal work.
about:
Rockport Steel operates from Rockport, Maine, on the state's Midcoast region. The company has been providing custom metal fabrication for over 30 years, beginning as a small boat-building operation with just a couple of employees. No founding year or founder names are disclosed.

Today the shop focuses on structural steel fabrication and custom architectural metalwork, offering forming, welding, cutting, consulting, technical drawings, and installation services. The team handles projects ranging from railings, stairs, fences, and gates to commercial signs, sculptures, docks, ramps, and boats, supported by 3D modeling and a boom truck for heavy placement.

The company serves both commercial and residential clients across construction, marine, architectural, and artistic sectors. Past work includes structural frameworks for buildings, custom railings for homes, marine docks and ramps, and large-scale sculptures.

Rockport Steel emphasizes superior quality and workmanship, aiming to exceed customer expectations through custom design collaboration that brings client ideas to life.
